caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass bowl positioned centrally on an off-white or beige background. The bowl is rendered with light blue and gray shading to indicate its glass material and to suggest reflections and highlights on its surface. The bowl has a wide, slightly flared rim and a rounded body that tapers inward before expanding slightly near the base. Around the bowl, there are four small, precise cross marks, one near each corner of the page, likely serving as registration or alignment guides. In the lower left quadrant, the name "J. Steinberg" is written in small, unobtrusive text. The composition is minimal, with the bowl being the sole object and no additional decorative elements present.
title: Sauce Dish
